# Group summary

**FAKE DATA. The clinical and FC tables behind this summary were made up by `mslb make-fake-data` to test the pipeline. Nothing below is a finding.**

Group-level results only. This file holds no subject IDs and no per-subject values,
so it can be shared. How to read each number: `docs/interpreting-results.md`.

- Scans processed: 30 of 30
- With clinical data: 30. With FC data: 30.
- Registration QC failures (no head-size or tract values): 0
- Lesion volumes in the tests are adjusted for head size (raw volume × head-size factor).
- All tests are two-sided. FC results carry Benjamini-Hochberg q-values, computed across
  connections within one exposure and one bladder state. Other p-values are unadjusted.
- Group statistics are withheld for groups smaller than 3.
- mslb 0.1.0, MindGlide 1.3.0, config 4e2551d9e8fe, finished 2026-11-17T05:35:11+00:00.
